definitions.explanation: The dark part of the day, from sunset until dawn.

examples.english: What do you do at night?
I go to bed at 10 o'clock every night.

examples.japanese: ⟦{昨日|きのう}→昨日：00859_kinou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{夜|よる}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{忙|いそが}しかった→忙しい：00591_isogashii⟧⟦です→です：09485_desu⟧。

notes:
{夜|よる} is the primary word for night, covering the period from sunset to dawn.

TIME OF DAY SEQUENCE:
- ⟦{朝|あさ}→朝：02277_asa⟧: morning
- ⟦{昼|ひる}→昼：00540_hiru⟧: daytime/noon
- ⟦{夕方|ゆうがた}→夕方：01010_yuugata⟧: evening
- {夜|よる}: night

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- {夜|よる}ごはん/⟦{晩|ばん}→晩：00542_ban⟧ごはん: dinner
- ⟦{今夜|こんや}→今夜：01411_konya⟧: tonight
- ⟦{昨夜|さくや}→昨夜：02999_sakuya⟧/⟦ゆうべ→ゆうべ：02487_yuube⟧: last night
- ⟦{毎晩|まいばん}→毎晩：00967_maiban⟧: every night
- ⟦{夜中|よなか}→夜中：01008_yonaka⟧: midnight, middle of the night
- {夜|よる}⟦{遅|おそ}く→遅い：00533_osoi⟧: late at night

COMPOUNDS:
- ⟦{夜行|やこう}→夜行：04078_yakou⟧バス: overnight bus
- ⟦{夜景|やけい}→夜景：noentry⟧: night view
- ⟦{夜勤|やきん}→夜勤：09549_yakin⟧: night shift

CONTRAST WITH ⟦{晩|ばん}→晩：00542_ban⟧:
{夜|よる} refers to night generally; ⟦{晩|ばん}→晩：00542_ban⟧ often refers specifically to evening/dinnertime.
